# Cool Hand Electric — LSA Call Wins Log (Oct 1–15, 2026)

Scope: Google Local Services Ads calls only. These calls don't go through CallRail. Lead list, status, and recordings were pulled from the Google Ads LSA API (account 9865206319, `local_services_lead` + `local_services_lead_conversation`) and transcribed locally.

**Caveat:** names and spelled details come from an auto-generated transcript on phone-quality audio. "Google status" is what the business marked in the LSA dashboard.

**Dispute candidate:** the 10-12 11:03 commercial nursing-home lead was **charged** even though Cool Hand referred it out as commercial work. Commercial jobs outside the business's service type are usually eligible for an LSA credit dispute.

**Outcome legend:** ✅ Booked · ⏳ Open/follow-up needed · ❌ No contact / not a lead
